## ES.dcl: Declarations

[Official text](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#s-expr)

- [ES.5: Keep scopes small](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#res-scope) · ours: [core-guidelines](../core-guidelines.md)

- [ES.9: Avoid `ALL_CAPS` names](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#res-not-caps)

- [ES.11: Use `auto` to avoid redundant repetition of type names](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#res-auto) · ours: [core-guidelines](../core-guidelines.md)
- [ES.12: Do not reuse names in nested scopes](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#res-reuse)
- [ES.20: Always initialize an object](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#res-always) · ours: [core-guidelines](../core-guidelines.md), [safety](../safety.md), [tooling](../tooling.md)
- [ES.21: Don't introduce a variable (or constant) before you need to use it](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#res-introduce) · ours: [core-guidelines](../core-guidelines.md)
- [ES.22: Don't declare a variable until you have a value to initialize it with](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#res-init) · ours: [core-guidelines](../core-guidelines.md)
- [ES.23: Prefer the `{}`-initializer syntax](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#res-list) · ours: [core-guidelines](../core-guidelines.md)
- [ES.24: Use a `unique_ptr<T>` to hold pointers](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#res-unique)
- [ES.25: Declare an object `const` or `constexpr` unless you want to modify its value later on](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#res-const)
- [ES.26: Don't use a variable for two unrelated purposes](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#res-recycle)
- [ES.27: Use `std::array` or `stack_array` for arrays on the stack](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#res-stack)

- [ES.30: Don't use macros for program text manipulation](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#res-macros)
- [ES.31: Don't use macros for constants or "functions"](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#res-macros2)
- [ES.32: Use `ALL_CAPS` for all macro names](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#res-all_caps)
- [ES.33: If you must use macros, give them unique names](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#res-macros3)
- [ES.34: Don't define a (C-style) variadic function](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#res-ellipses)

## ES.stmt: Statements

[Official text](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#s-expr)

- [ES.70: Prefer a `switch`-statement to an `if`-statement when there is a choice](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#res-switch-if)

- [ES.76: Avoid `goto`](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#res-goto)

- [ES.78: Don't rely on implicit fallthrough in `switch` statements](https://isocpp.github.io/CppCoreGuidelines/CppCoreGuidelines#res-break)
